caption_profile.measurement_basis: Captions are authored on the recomposed 9:16 canvas itself, so the effective displayed size is the authored size on that canvas (the typography tokens' full-frame / recomposed-canvas basis). The floor itself never scales down.

qc_profile.font_declaration: The QC-facing assets record in the delivery package declares each font requirement under its resolved family name (the runtime registry's resolution of the canonical alias), following the MG-035 delivery-stage convention; the intake assets record with the canonical alias token is retained beside it as intake-assets.json. The gate's alias handling itself is a separate pending checker fix (recorded at MG-037); this layer declares the resolved name and discloses it rather than hiding the seam.

recomposition_proof.method: Decode frames from the rendered vertical artifact and measure the chart in the portrait layout's own coordinates: bar widths at the half-reveal and final frames against the portrait derivation from the dataset and the portrait plot width, and bar row centroids against the portrait row positions. The same measurements are compared against the two forbidden derivations (a uniform scale of the landscape master to the mobile width, and a center crop of the landscape master scaled to the mobile height); the portrait measurements must match the portrait derivation and differ from both counterfactuals.

statement: Governed configuration for the mobile VSL derivative. The vertical presentation is its own composition: a 9:16 canvas planned from the same approved message, asset identities, dataset, and parent narration as the desktop VSL, with chart geometry re-derived from the design record's portrait layout. It is never a crop, a uniform scale, or a letterbox of the desktop master, and this configuration names the checks that prove it.
